data.name: AlJalilah
data.gender_notes: AlJalilah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'J-L-L', which means to be exalted, glorified, or to rise high above others. In Islamic tradition, AlJalilah is a name given to the One True God, Allah, who is the most exalted and glorified being. The name AlJalilah carries the meaning “The Exalted One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlJalilah usually hope their child will grow to embody the exalted one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes reverence and awe for the Almighty.
data.etymology: AlJalilah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Exalted One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlJalilah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_urdu.name: الجليلة
in_urdu.meaning: الجليلة نام ایک پاک و نیک نام ہے، جس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے بڑا، عظیم، ممتاز اور اللہ تعالیٰ کا نیک نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: الجليلة نام اللہ تعالیٰ کا ایک نیک نام ہے، جو اللہ تعالیٰ کے جلال اور عظمت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام قرآن کریم میں بھی موجود ہے، جہاں اللہ تعالیٰ کے جلال اور عظمت کا ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔ نام کا مطلب ہوتا ہے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ بڑا، عظیم اور ممتاز ہے، اور اس کی جلال اور عظمت کو ہر کسی کے سامنے ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_english.name: AlJalilah
in_english.meaning: AlJalilah is a beautiful and noble name, meaning the greatness and majesty of Allah
in_english.long_meaning: AlJalilah is a name of Arabic origin, meaning the Greatness and Majesty of Allah. This name is derived from the Arabic root word "J-L-L", which means to be great, majestic, and glorious. In the Quran, this name is used to describe the greatness and majesty of Allah, and is considered a beautiful and noble name in Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The name AlJalilah is not commonly used as a personal name among Muslims, but it holds a significant cultural value as a reverential name for Allah. In Islamic literature and poetry, AlJalilah is often used interchangeably with other Names of Allah that convey His majesty and greatness, such as Al-Aziz (The Almighty) and Al-Khaliq (The Creator). By invoking this name and reciting it with devotion, Muslims strive to remember and revere the supremacy and power of Allah in their lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The name AlJalilah carries a profound spiritual significance for Muslims, encapsulating the essence of submission and humility before Allah. By acknowledging Allah as AlJalilah, the Most Exalted and Glorified One, Muslims are reminded of their smallness and insignificance in the grand scheme of things. This understanding fosters a deep sense of awe, reverence, and obedience towards Allah, inspiring Muslims to live in accordance with His Will and Guidance. Moreover, remembrance of Allah's Name AlJalilah serves as a constant reminder of the transcendent nature of Allah, reminding Muslims to avoid merely focusing on material worldly matters and instead prioritize their spiritual growth and connection with the Divine.
